info.title: Sentinel API
info.description:
REST API for gathering Linux server and Docker Engine metrics.

Sentinel collects system metrics (CPU, memory) and Docker container statistics, storing them in SQLite and providing both current and historical data through REST endpoints.

This service is designed for integration with [Coolify.io](https://coolify.io).

get.description:
Top values of one dimension for one app, summed across every bucket
in range. A synthetic `__other__` entry absorbs the long tail past
the server's top-N cap (TRAFFIC_TOPN). An unrecognized dimension
returns an empty array, not an error.

Requires Sentinel built with the `traffic` Cargo feature AND `TRAFFIC_ENABLED=true` at runtime; returns 404 otherwise.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: App UUID

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description:
One of: status, method, country, referer, browser, os, device,
protocol, scheme, tls, cache, bot, agent, ip, useragent. The
`agent` dimension holds the bot/AI-agent name (e.g. GPTBot,
ClaudeBot) and is only present for bot traffic. `ip` holds the
resolved real client IP (respecting Cloudflare CF-Connecting-IP
and X-Forwarded-For); `useragent` holds the raw User-Agent header.

get.description:
Bundle every traffic shape into one response so a dashboard can replace
~15 separate requests with a single call. Each member is verbatim the
shape of its standalone endpoint, with the same server-side sketch
merges (t-digest latency, HLL uniques) — nothing is re-summed.

`overview`, `paths`, and every `breakdowns` dimension follow `from`/`to`;
`series` follows `range`. The server-wide variant includes `apps` (every
app with traffic, ranked by requests desc, capped at `apps_limit`). An
empty range returns 200 with zeroed/empty members, never 404.

Additive: older Coolify keeps calling the individual endpoints; new
Coolify calls this first and falls back to them on 404.

Requires Sentinel built with the `traffic` Cargo feature AND `TRAFFIC_ENABLED=true` at runtime; returns 404 otherwise.

parameters.description:
Start date in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Defaults to the Unix epoch
(all recorded history) when omitted.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Defaults to now when omitted.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Time range for the series member: `24h` (default), `7d`, or `30d`.

parameters.name: paths_limit
parameters.description: Top-N cap for the paths member. Positive integer, max 1000, default 50.

parameters.name: breakdown_limit
parameters.description: Top-N cap for each breakdown member. Positive integer, max 1000, default 50.

parameters.name: apps_limit
parameters.description:
Top-N cap for the apps leaderboard (server-wide dashboard only; ignored
on the per-app variant). Positive integer, max 1000, default 200.

200.description: Aggregate dashboard, including the app leaderboard

get.description:
Request/bandwidth totals, status-class counts, latency percentiles,
and estimated unique visitors merged across every app and host on the
box. Sketches (t-digest, HyperLogLog) are merged server-side, so the
percentiles and visitor estimate are a true cross-app merge, not a sum
of per-app estimates. Same shape as the per-app overview.

Requires Sentinel built with the `traffic` Cargo feature AND `TRAFFIC_ENABLED=true` at runtime; returns 404 otherwise.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Start date in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Defaults to the Unix epoch
(all recorded history) when omitted.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Defaults to now when omitted.

get.description:
Busiest request paths across every app on the box, summed over the
range with per-path latency. Rows are keyed by `(app, path)`: the same path served by
multiple apps stays a separate entry per app, each labelled with its
owning `app`, giving a correct top-N across all apps that preserves
per-app attribution.

Requires Sentinel built with the `traffic` Cargo feature AND `TRAFFIC_ENABLED=true` at runtime; returns 404 otherwise.

get.description: Get the current version of Sentinel

ContainerDiskUsage.description: Per-container storage: Docker writable-layer size plus summed volume sizes.

CpuCurrent.description:
Current CPU usage. WIRE FORMAT IS FROZEN: `percent` is a NUMBER here,
unlike /api/cpu/history where it is a string. Do not "fix" this.

CpuUsage.description:
WIRE FORMAT IS FROZEN. `percent` is a string here (history endpoints) but a
number in /api/cpu/current. Do not "fix" this — Coolify parses it as-is.

DiskUsage.description:
Server filesystem usage for one mountpoint. These endpoints are new (not
part of the frozen Go wire format), so `time` is a stringified millis for
consistency with the other series while byte fields stay numeric.

MemUsage.description: WIRE FORMAT IS FROZEN. `usedPercent` is the only camelCase key in the API.

StatsResponse.description: Database storage statistics and estimated logical table sizes.

storage_usage_kb.description: Human-readable strings ("{:.2}"), part of the wire format.

size_mb.description: Human-readable strings ("{:.2}"), part of the wire format.

TrafficAppEntry.description:
One row of the server-wide app leaderboard: an app UUID plus its overview,
ranked by request count descending.

TrafficAttribution.description:
The attribution string required by the license of whichever GeoIP source
is currently active (design spec §6), or `null` when none applies (GeoIP
disabled, not yet resolved, or an unrecognized `GEOIP_DB_URL` override).

TrafficBreakdownEntry.description:
One value of a breakdown dimension (country, device, status class, ...),
summed over every bucket in the range.

TrafficBreakdowns.description:
The eleven breakdown dimensions Coolify renders, each a top-N list in the
same shape as `GET /traffic/breakdown/{dim}`. A fixed struct rather than a
map so the dimension set is the single source of truth and always complete.

TrafficDashboard.description:
Everything Coolify's traffic dashboard needs in one payload, so it can
replace ~15 separate round-trips with a single request. Every member is the
verbatim shape of its standalone endpoint — the same serializers and
server-side sketch merges — bundled, never re-summed.

apps.description:
Per-app leaderboard, present only on the server-wide dashboard and
omitted entirely on the per-app variant.

attribution.description:
The active GeoIP attribution string, or `null`. Flattened out of
[`TrafficAttribution`] so the dashboard carries the bare value.

TrafficLatency.description:
Approximate latency quantiles in milliseconds (t-digest estimate). `0.0`
on every field when the range holds no decodable latency sketch.

TrafficOverview.description:
App-level traffic totals for a query range, merged across *every* host
that served the app (per-host detail is deliberately not exposed here).

unique_visitors.description: Approximate distinct client IPs (HyperLogLog++ estimate, ~1-2% error).

TrafficPath.description:
One row of the top-paths table, summed over every bucket in the range.
Carries only p50/p95 — p99 is omitted deliberately to keep a 50-row
payload small, and the app-level p99 is available from the overview.

app.description:
The app (Coolify app UUID, or host for Caddy) that served this path,
so a server-wide response can attribute each path back to its owning
app/domain. On a per-app endpoint every row carries the queried app.

TrafficSeriesBucket.description:
One time bucket of traffic totals, for the series endpoints. `bucket` is
the unix-millis start of the bucket (hour- or day-aligned by the request's
`range`). Counters are zero for buckets with no traffic.

`unique_visitors` is a per-bucket HyperLogLog++ estimate (the bucket's own
sketches merged, ~1-2% error) — it is *not* additive across buckets, so a
sum of these will overcount a range's true distinct visitors. `p95` is the
bucket's 95th-percentile latency in ms (t-digest estimate), `0.0` when the
bucket holds no decodable latency sketch.

TrafficStatusBreakdown.description: Request counts by HTTP status class.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token authentication. Set the TOKEN environment variable when running Sentinel and include it in the Authorization header.
